This is Box Office Numbers. It was created for the DATASCI350 course quiz.
The dataset has 104 well-known films from 1980 to 2025, with approximate budgets, worldwide revenues, runtimes, and ratings. 
Three detailed analysis pages:

- [Runtime and Ratings](runtime-rating.qmd)
